findings.summary: Six frozen baseline items are absent from both accessible current restaurant-issued menus and the current linked Toast ordering menu: Asparagi, Carciofo, Rhubarb Coffee Cake, Angel Food Cake, Aventino Tiramisu, and Mascarpone Cheesecake.

The current menu presents Chocolate Nemesis Cake rather than a separate Chocolate Nemesis item, Chocolate Chip Cookies rather than Cookie Plate, and Gelato Selection containing gelato and sorbetto rather than a separately named Gelato e Sorbetto item.

Current restaurant-issued ingredient text and the restaurant-linked Toast allergen labels expose material unsupported or conflicting baseline allergen claims. Examples include anchovy/fish absent from Acciughe e Burro's baseline claim, gluten absent from the baseline Suppli al Telefono claim, a current flourless Chocolate Nemesis Cake conflicting with baseline wheat/gluten, and Toast's Milanese label adding finfish while the baseline does not.

The current restaurant-issued menu provides ingredient descriptions but no allergen legend or allergen labels. Toast is explicitly linked by the restaurant and labels only part of the current ordering menu, so it cannot establish a complete official allergen source for every item.

summary: Aventino Cucina Bethesda identity is verified and all 55 frozen audit items were reconciled exactly once. The accessible current menus retain most names, but six baseline items are absent and three are only current variants. Current ingredient and linked-Toast allergen evidence identifies material conflicts in seven baseline allergen records; the restaurant-issued menu itself has no allergen legend. Escalate for discrepancy adjudication; this result does not make a terminal verification claim.
